rationale: The original entry premise relied on confluence support at the session VWAP ($19.17) and 5-minute 9-EMA ($19.16), both of which have now failed as price has drifted down to $19.12 across five consecutive lower 1-minute closes. Simultaneously, broader market tailwinds have weakened with SPY pulling back from +0.60% at entry to +0.34%. Closing here cuts the loss early before the hard stop at $19.05 is tested, while strong intraday relative volume (3.36x) and the initial 8% gap deter an immediate flip to short.
